data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through improving our search engine ranking and results. Recent projects include:

  1. Improving first-phase ranking quality and precision without sacrificing latency

  2. Developing new lexical-matching and document-authority signals

  3. Expanding our search evaluations to measure relevancy readiness and surface ranking blindspots

  4. Investigating LLMs for feature generation and ranking

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

About You

  • You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, with 2+ years at Staff, Principal, or Director level, and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

  • You are comfortable advising others on complex data science work.

  • You can develop strategies for ambiguous, complex data science problems and turn them into a series of well-defined projects.

  • You have hands-on experience deploying ML in production, developing NLP solutions, and in AI-assisted development.

  • You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

  • You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills.

  • You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

  • Preferred experience:

    • Running search-specific projects (ranking, retrieval, or indexing) from scoping to production

    • Working with large-scale search infrastructure (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Solr)

Compensation

data.description:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About You:

You are a German speaking Account Manager, excited to join a growing team focused on demonstrating ownership of our clients’ experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You will work closely with members of the Customer Success team, Sales team, and other internal Constructor teams to support and grow your book of business. You are an advocate for your customer and work with internal teams to provide feedback to Product, create advocacy opportunities for Marketing, and visibility into use cases and customer health for the organization. You demonstrate a high degree of accountability and ownership.

Responsibilities:

  • You are the strategic lead for the clients in your book of business.

  • You will build strong relationships with your clients in order to understand their business goals, business needs, the priorities of these goals and needs, and how Constructor maps to these goals and needs.

  • You will manage complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level).

  • You will uncover and manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner.

  • You will grow to be well versed on your clients’ business needs and the Constructor product in order to educate clients on potential new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities.

  • You will regularly update internal systems and attend internal meetings in order to document and communicate customer status, needs, risk, renewal next steps, and upsell next steps.

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3+ Years of proven experience working directly with large enterprise clients a role within Account Management, Customer Success, and/or Sales within a SaaS company, preferably one that works directly with ecommerce clients.

  • German Language skills are a MUST!

  • Proven ability to influence, present to, and build deep relationships with our customers, especially at the VP+ level.

  • Proven ability to uncover and properly manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner.

  • Proven ability to educate clients on new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities.

  • Proven ability in managing complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level).

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual retention and expansion goals.

  • Attend and ensure the success of Quarterly Business Reviews with Customers to ensure understanding of client goals and how Constructor maps to those goals.

  • Proven ability to juggle multiple Account Management projects and recurring responsibilities at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Proven ability to work cross functionally with various teams to meet the aforementioned needs and goals of your clients - this includes, but is not limited to, working with Sales, CSMs, SEs, SAs, Data Science teams, Product+Eng teams. This includes the ability to tailor language and asks for these teams while maintaining an eye on timeline, SLAs, and the overall client goals and needs.

  • Solid knowledge and understanding of ecommerce business needs - typical goals, KPIs, terminology, and trends.

  • Proven ability to acquire and maintain a working knowledge of the complete capabilities of Constructor’s ever-evolving products and capabilities.

You’re comfortable communicating complex technical solutions in a written form, and you know how to keep customers informed while you investigate. You’re a problem solver who’s passionate about removing roadblocks, creating scalable solutions, and championing the customer’s voice at every stage. You’re a strong troubleshooter who is passionate about removing roadblocks, improving support processes, and making it easier for customers and internal teams to get to the right answer faster. For you, every support interaction is a chance to earn trust and leave the customer better off than when they reached out.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, explicitly optimizing for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world, including some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who loves solving problems and making our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S.-based company that has been in the market since 2015. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick, who still lead the company today.

About the Position

As a Technical Support Engineer on our EMEA team, you’ll be part of the support-founding team, a reliable technical resource for enterprise customers, helping them troubleshoot issues, understand Constructor behavior, and move forward with confidence. You’ll own and drive customer-facing technical support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, especially for issues involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, event instrumentation, tagging, and implementation behavior. You'll act as a supportive partner, bridging the gap between technical issues and successful resolutions, ensuring customers feel supported throughout each interaction.You’ll investigate technical hurdles, communicate clearly while work is in progress, coordinate with internal teams when escalation is needed, and make sure customers understand the resolution and next steps.

You can dive into a payload or a log review, drive technical implementation guides and communicate clear solutions in tickets with equal ease, but consistently earning trust within every interaction is what sets you apart. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, high-quality customer communication, and improving the systems that help a support team scale.

You will…

  • Provide clear, timely, and technically sound support on complex inbound questions involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, tagging, event instrumentation, and implementation behavior.

  • Own customer-facing technical support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, making sure customers understand what we know, what we are investigating, and what happens next.

  • Earn trust across technical and business stakeholders by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and distilling complex technical issues into simple, actionable next steps.

  • Troubleshoot issues by reviewing payloads, logs, API behavior, configuration, and implementation details, then guiding customers toward a resolution.

  • Review and improve self-service bot answers, flag automation gaps, and help tune escalation criteria.

  • Support in creating and maintaining knowledge base and documentation.

  • Support EMEA customers with responsiveness, strong written communication, and ownership during regional business hours.

  • Identify patterns in customer tickets, recurring questions, and support pain points, then share clear feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the customer experience.

  • Collaborate with customer developers, data teams, Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot issues, clarify implementation questions, and support successful resolutions.

  • Proactively investigate and resolve blockers across data ingestion, tagging, event instrumentation, and API performance, especially when those blockers affect launch, customer confidence, or ongoing platform usage.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Constructor’s technical architecture, helping customers understand expected behavior, integration options, and how to troubleshoot issues in their environment.

  • Translate customer issues into clear internal context for Product and Engineering, including impact, reproduction steps, examples, urgency, and customer-facing implications.

  • Create and improve reusable technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, macros, internal notes, and support workflows that help the team resolve issues more consistently and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Solutions, Product, and Engineering so customers receive consistent guidance and internal teams have the context they need.

  • Continuously improve support processes, playbooks, and escalation paths to reduce friction, improve response quality, and help customers get to value faster.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or customer-facing engineering role.

  • Hands-on experience working with APIs, SDKs, logs, HTTP requests, event data, and technical implementation details.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially in tickets, Slack, and customer calls, with the ability to explain technical complexity in simple, actionable language.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, including situations with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high urgency.

  • Ability to manage customer expectations, communicate clearly under pressure, and drive issues forward across internal and external teams.

  • Track record of building or improving support processes, documentation, troubleshooting guides, or tooling that improves team efficiency and customer outcomes.

  • Proven ability to manage complex technical support cases from intake to resolution, balancing speed, accuracy, customer communication, and internal escalation when needed.

  • Strong desire to learn quickly, adapt, and improve how we support customers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Familiarity with JavaScript-based web integrations, HTTP request flows, browser developer tools, and client-side / server-side contexts is a plus, but customer communication, not coding, is your superpower.

  • Ability to support customers during EMEA business hours.

  • Bonus: familiarity with A/B testing, ecommerce search or discovery, network request routing, and HTTP troubleshooting.

data.description:
About Us 

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential.

What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond 
Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources 
A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement 
Flexible working with a remote first working policy

Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you

Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers

At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. Delivery Manager – Biomechanics

Join Our Team at Sony Sports Technology

Value Stream: Biomechanics

Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Office locations: Basingstoke, London or Bristol

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Salary: £42,000 - £66,000

 

About the Team

Hi, we're Amy Ogren and Robert Hulbert, and we're looking for a Delivery Manager to join our growing Biomechanics Value Stream. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing areas within Sony Sports Technology. Our team combines Hawk-Eye's world-leading tracking technology with KinaTrax's markerless motion capture systems to provide cutting-edge athlete performance insights across elite sport.

You'll be joining a collaborative team of around 20 people that's expected to grow to approximately 25 over the coming year. Unlike many delivery roles that focus on a single product or sport, you'll support initiatives across Major League Baseball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, cricket, tennis and golf.

You'll also be joining at an exciting time as we continue delivering one of Sony Sports Technology's largest strategic partnerships while helping shape the future of biomechanics technology.

 

About the Role

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems and helping technical teams deliver their best work.

As a Delivery Manager, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Solution Owners and software engineers to coordinate the delivery of technical initiatives across our biomechanics products.

You'll help keep projects moving by managing priorities, coordinating dependencies, identifying risks early and ensuring teams have the information they need to deliver successfully.

This isn't a traditional project management role. Priorities can change quickly as new opportunities emerge across multiple sports, so we're looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where no two weeks are quite the same.

 

What You'll Work On

  • Supporting delivery across multiple biomechanics products and sports initiatives.

  • Coordinating work across engineering, product and operational teams.

  • Managing delivery roadmaps, milestones and project planning activities.

  • Supporting Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and delivery processes.

  • Tracking project progress and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery.

  • Identifying risks, dependencies and blockers before they impact delivery.

  • Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads and Solution Owners to coordinate priorities.

  • Helping improve delivery processes and ways of working across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Building strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders across Sony Sports Technology.

 

What Success Looks Like

Your first few months will focus on learning the products, understanding how our teams work and building strong relationships across the business.

As your confidence grows, you'll begin taking ownership of delivery activities, supporting roadmap planning, identifying delivery risks and helping improve the way the team collaborates.

Success in this role isn't about changing everything on day one. It's about learning quickly, building trust and becoming someone the team relies on to help deliver complex technical projects successfully.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the successful delivery of initiatives across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Maintain delivery roadmaps, milestones and project timelines across multiple workstreams.

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and backlog refinement.

  • Track project dependencies, risks and blockers, ensuring they are managed proactively.

  • Support Product Managers and Engineering Leads with delivery planning and prioritisation.

  • Monitor delivery health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.

  • Escalate delivery risks with clear recommendations and proposed mitigation plans.

  • Help improve Agile delivery practices, team collaboration and operational efficiency.

  • Support cross-functional communication between engineering, product, operations and business teams.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency and accountability.

 

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

We're looking for someone with:

  • Experience supporting software, technical or product delivery within a technology environment.

  • An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

  • Experience using Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration and planning tools.

  • Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working alongside engineering or technical teams.

  • A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

  • A genuine interest in technology and delivering high-quality products.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to sports technology or biomechanics.

  • Experience working across multiple technical teams.

  • An understanding of software development lifecycles.

  • A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Sports Science, Biomechanics, Project Management or a related discipline is preferred, but not essential.

 

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join one of the most exciting growth areas within Sony Sports Technology.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers and delivery specialists on technology that's helping redefine athlete performance analysis across professional sport.

As the Biomechanics Value Stream continues to expand, you'll have the opportunity to broaden your experience across multiple sports, contribute to high-profile programmes and develop your career within a growing global team.

Own the financials for Tech - from headcount to AI and tooling spend; to capex modelling and strategy; to investment tracking and ROI reporting.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications are open until 2nd September 2026 09.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date. Please do not rush and use this time to submit a high quality application!

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in.

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational.

  • Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity.

  • Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.

  • Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.

  • Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.

  • Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.

  • Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.

  • Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.

What you bring

  • Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.

  • Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.

  • A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority.

  • Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime.

  • Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.

This role is a good fit if:

  • You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.

  • You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

  • You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

  2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.

  5. Final interview: A 45-minutes interview with one of our senior leaders, focusing on assessing behavioural skills and values alignment.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. This means it's a very senior position where you need to demonstrate experience leading technical initiatives that can have organisation-wide or cross-team impact for a tech business of 500-1000+ people. data.title: Business Development Manager
data.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Are you a high-performing sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager (BDM) to take full ownership of our highest-volume inbound sales channel.

Unlike traditional split sales roles, this position grants you complete end-to-end ownership of the customer journey—from initial engagement and discovery to product demonstration, negotiation, and closing. You will be responsible for converting high-intent inbound marketing leads into long-term clients, driving core growth across our key revenue segment. Rather than building bespoke proposals for every opportunity, the Business Development Manager sells from a defined package portfolio, allowing them to manage a high volume of opportunities efficiently while delivering a consistent customer experience.

What you will be doing:

  • End-to-End Pipeline Ownership: Manage the full sales cycle from initial inbound inquiry through to contract execution and client onboarding.

  • Lead Qualification & Discovery: Evaluate inbound marketing opportunities against ideal customer profiles (ICP) to assess fit and commercial value.

  • Product Demonstrations: Conduct compelling discovery calls and engage prospects with tailored product demonstrations.

  • Package Presentation: Match prospect needs with predefined solution packages (hardware, software, payments) to drive fast decision-making and rapid implementation.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Confidently manage objections, present commercial proposals, and close new business to meet or exceed targets.

  • CRM & Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate, real-time records in the CRM to ensure accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline tracking.

  • Target Achievement: Consistently deliver against core sales metrics, including revenue targets, conversion rates, and activity KPIs.

And a little bit of....

  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

What you need to bring:

  • Collaborative and solution-focused, with a strategic mindset and the resilience to navigate challenges and drive results.

  • Proven track record in an end-to-end sales role (closing deals independently without relying on separate SDR/AE splits).

  • Comfort managing multiple opportunities simultaneously in a fast-paced inbound environment.

  • Ability to qualify leads quickly, uncover core customer pain points, and align them with structured product packages.

  • Prior experience selling integrated tech solutions (hardware, SaaS, or payment/fintech platforms) is highly desirable.

  • Excellent commercial acumen with a history of hitting and exceeding quota targets.

  • CRM Mastery: Strong discipline with pipeline management and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

What's in it for you?

You will learn everything about us, our story, the colleagues, our workflow and you will receive a practical onboarding. We have the ability to move fast like an innovative start-up with the expertise and capabilities of a global scale-up. The result: a team of both new and experienced professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who recognise and reward your work.

You will be part of a team that likes to work together, help each other, share insights and achieve success. Before you know it, we'll be celebrating your first deal together!

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy, and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Company pension program

  • Health and wellness benefit

  • Flexible PTO

  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services

  • Paid leave and assistance for new parents

  • Language classes & LinkedIn Learning license

  • Volunteer day

Read more about all Lightspeed benefits on our career page

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Capability Overview

In Jellyfish Creative, we embed Gen AI at our core to create, adapt, connect and optimise award-winning content at scale. In 150+ markets. For the world’s leading brands. Our creative model combines tech-driven ideation with human-generated social creativity, connecting all 400 creative and experienced experts across the globe, powered by the integration of Pencil Pro. AI Studios is where creative talent supercharges Jellyfish’s market-leading experience in content, production, transcreation and localisation generating content at scale and our most dynamic, diverse, and inspiring talent forms the award-winning Creative Collective, focusing on human-generated social creative with cultural relevance that can live on any platform or medium. Creating end-to-end solutions that bring audience expectations and platform algorithms together with relevance, clarity and cultural resonance.

Job Description

As a Senior Design Manager, you’ll be responsible for leading and managing the design process on client projects, ensuring briefs are accurately understood and executed. Working closely with your Project Manager and Senior Design Capability Support, you'll help streamline workflows and elevate the quality of the design work produced. This role provides the opportunity to contribute to both the creation of impactful assets and the development of the design community at Jellyfish, all while focusing on continuous growth and excellence.

You’ll be a key player in delivering high-quality design assets, including static and animated digital content for social media, and will have the opportunity to foster innovation within a global team. By embracing both creative and technical processes, you’ll help ensure smooth project onboarding and contribute to the team’s overall success. Additionally, you’ll have the opportunity to leverage the AI platform Pencil Pro, enhancing your design process and helping to generate even more effective, data-driven creative assets.

The salary range for this position is between £50,000-60,000 GBP, annually, and final offer is based upon experience. This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Create a diverse range of digital and print design assets, focusing on social media content, including both static and animated designs.

  • Utilize design software like Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) to produce high-quality assets.

  • Understand and apply interactive design principles, ensuring engaging and user-friendly outcomes.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Motion Graphics and Video Editing, utilizing tools such as Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.

  • Leverage knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to effectively communicate with development teams and understand technical possibilities.

  • Stay current with the latest digital design trends, AI tools like ChatGPT, and integrate them into your design process to enhance creative output.

  • Leverage the AI platform Pencil Pro to streamline your creative workflow, generating optimized designs based on data and client insights.

  • Align closely with Project Managers and the creative team to promptly receive and develop project briefs.

  • Actively participate in project kick-off meetings and review all relevant project materials to ensure understanding of scope and objectives.

  • Understand project timelines and deadlines, ensuring deliverables are completed on schedule.

  • Interrogate briefs and ask for clarification on any required materials or project details to avoid miscommunication.

  • Ensure project scope, role, and hours are well-understood and accurately tracked in Financial Force.

  • Demonstrate a proactive approach by asking questions and seeking clarification when necessary.

  • Actively participate in internal and external meetings, maintaining clear communication with team members and clients.

  • Respond to feedback and concerns from clients and colleagues in a professional, constructive manner.

  • Participate in collaborative activities and communication channels with the broader project and capability teams.

Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency in English.

  • 5+ of experience in a senior design role, preferably within an agency or similar environment.

  • Ability to follow design processes, confidentiality protocols, and file organization standards.

  • Strong innovative thinking and problem-solving skills, contributing valuable insights during brainstorming sessions.

  • Expertise in design tools like Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign Illustrator and After Effects).

  • Solid understanding of design principles and typography, with the ability to create effective layouts, ensuring sharp attention to detail across various channels.

  • Knowledgeable about digital design principles and how to apply them across multiple formats and platforms.

  • Familiar with brand guidelines and experienced in adapting them across various projects.

  • Strong ability to combine speed and technique to produce high-quality assets efficiently, even at scale.

  • Creative problem solver with the ability to contribute strategically and think outside the box.

  • Skilled in quality control (QC) for your own work and understanding project workflows to ensure smooth delivery.

  • Up-to-date with the latest design trends, techniques, and emerging technologies.

  • Able to export and optimize assets to meet platform specifications and best practices, ensuring file size and naming conventions are followed.

  • Unafraid to raise concerns and suggest improvements to the team, particularly if issues arise during the project or process

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK - WITH FIELD TRAVEL

 

THE LAST FRONTIER

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

 

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

 

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

 

THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own the design, build, and deployment of cold-hardened hardware — from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms. You’ll work from first principles to engineer real-world solutions that operate where failure isn’t an option. You’ll lead end-to-end design, push hardware and material limits, and take your work into the field — from the workshop to the Arctic.

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, test, and deliver Arctic-ready hardware from cradle to deployment for ARD’s product-line

  • Drive materials choices, joinery, sealing, and reliability under thermal/mechanical stress

  • Run cold-chamber and durability testing, along with Test Engineer, to ensure performance in sub-zero climates

  • Integrate closely with electrical, software, and deployment teams (systems, software, GIS, RF)

  • Set QA standards to ensure our systems stay bulletproof in the harshest conditions

  • Travel to the Arctic for R&D field testing and meetings with industry reps

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years industry experience developing hardware for extreme environments

  • A degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with a portfolio of high-fidelity hardware development

  • Advanced skills in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, PDM)

  • Experience with taking a product from concept design to production, with a strong grasp of DfMA

  • Hands-on prototype and testing experience, working alongside multi-disciplinary engineering teams

  • Readiness to operate in safe but cold environments while conducting R&D prototype field tests

 

DESIRABLE SKILLS

  • Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock)

  • Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design

  • Basic understanding of RF systems and components

  • Previous experience working within an R&D workshop


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

  • Equity: meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

  • Private Healthcare for you and your family, including dental and optical

  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

  • Real field exposure: travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed (genuinely, not as a gimmick)

  • Mission-driven culture: focus on impact, not hours logged

data.title: Software Engineer (Platform)
data.description:
About Us

At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.


The Role

This role reports to our Head of Platform, Jack. Working with him and the platform engineering pod, you'll accelerate the development of algo1's platform, turning enterprise-grade platform expectations into software that our product pods and customers rely on.

You'll work primarily in the backend and on the infrastructure that underpins it, but the shopper and retailer experience will never be far from your mind.

Delivering a great platform means product engineers can ship quality, scalable solutions; product, design, and non-technical colleagues can prototype ideas quickly using our application code and production data as a baseline; shoppers have responsive, personalised in-store experiences; and retailers and brands can configure, monitor, and analyse their campaigns across potentially billions of data points.

We're agentic-first. Every engineer has access to frontier AI tooling and our own coding harness, and we expect you to use them to move faster, attempt more ambitious work, and stay fully accountable for what you ship.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, though Staff engineers and ambitious early-career engineers with strong platform instincts will also be considered.

What You'll Own

  • Product security. Own authentication across algo1, retailer and brand employees, shoppers, devices, agents, and third-party services, alongside authorisation covering RBAC and ReBAC.

  • Release engineering. Develop and maintain reliable, consistent automated release cycles that get changes to production safely and quickly.

  • Cloud environments. Manage the environments that support prototyping features across our Android and web applications alongside changes to one or more of our backend microservices.

  • API and event-driven architecture. Gatekeep the quality of our APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architecture in an open contributor model.

  • Agentic enablement. Continually improve our internal agentic harnesses (skills, context, and tooling) that allow other engineers and less technical colleagues to develop and prototype on our platform.

  • Agentic automation. Add agentic automation to all appropriate areas of the platform stack without compromising on quality.

 

About You

Must Have

  • Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.

  • API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.

  • Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.

  • Real-time data. Experience processing or analysing real-time data streams at scale.

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience deploying and operating distributed services on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.

  • Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.

  • AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

 

Nice to Have (or We Can Teach)

  • Polyglot engineer. Professional software engineering experience across the stack, with your strongest work in the platform, and a portfolio of production systems you've owned end-to-end.

  • B2B or enterprise product experience. Background building for business or enterprise customers, where reliability, integrations, and data pipelines matter as much as the interface.

  • Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.

  • Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.

  • Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, or customer personalisation systems.

  • Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.

 

How We Work

We're a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you're happiest when you're creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you'll love it here.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to build.

What We Offer

  • Direct access to our founders and a real voice in the calls that shape the product and the company.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Team offsites.

  • Cycle to work scheme

data.title: Partnership Account Manager UK
data.description:
About fonio

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.
We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Your Role

As Partner Manager UK you own the British and Irish partner channel end to end. Acquisition, activation, and enablement are all yours. You bring new partners in, you get them to their first closed deal, and you give them the resources they need to sell fonio on their own. You handle the full partner base in your market, except the strategic accounts.
This is not desk based partner management. You sell alongside your partners, you sit in their customer calls, and you build the playbooks and materials that make them independent.
What you will own

  • Acquisition: You identify and screen potential partners across the UK and Ireland. You assess their real potential and decide how each one gets handled.

  • Activation: You get partners to their first joint closed deal. You run the sales calls yourself so the partner sees a strong sales process live and learns from it. You join larger customer negotiations.

  • Enablement: You teach partners how to sell fonio. You build and provide the resources they need, from pitch material to objection handling, and you are their go to contact for questions.

  • Account Management: Regular check ins with your partners, unlocking upsell potential in their existing customer base, and opening new customers through and for your partners.

Your targets and KPIs

  • Revenue through partners

  • Number of qualified partners per quarter

  • Number of activated partners (first joint deal closed)

  • Activation rate and repeat activation rate

  • Upsell rate in the existing base

Who we are looking for

  • Languages: English native is a must. German, French, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.

  • Sales background, ideally you have walked the SDR to AE path yourself. Channel or partner experience is an advantage.

  • Hands on closer mentality. You sell yourself and train partners at the same time.

  • Strong self discipline, a real sense of ownership, and genuine drive to prove yourself.

  • You are up for the Vienna start and the move to London afterwards, and you are willing to travel for partner visits and larger customer negotiations on site.

Hiring Process

  • 15 min intro

  • 45 min skill interview & case study with David

  • 20 min Deep dive with our CCO Alex

  • 20 min culture fit with both founders

Compensation: £70K – £120K • Offers Equity

data.description:
Role: Head of Data Engineering

Location: Manchester based office – Hybrid working

Package: £90k OTE

 

PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation. 

To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 

 

The role: What you will do: 

  • Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
  • Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.
  • Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards.
  • Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.
  • Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies.

 

This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has: 

  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams.
  • A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures.
  • A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines.
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability.
  • Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices.
  • Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Nice to have experience: 

  • Experience integrating data with operational systems, including reverse ETL into platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

 

Why PHMG Tech:  

The IT, Development and Data functions within PHMG continue to evolve how we use technology and data to deliver value to the business. We want to build an open, collaborative culture where people communicate honestly, support each other and take pride in delivering good work. 

 

About PHMG: 

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.
